title: Digital Money
definition: Digital money refers to monetary value that is stored, managed, and exchanged exclusively through electronic computer systems, networks, and digital wallets, possessing no mandatory physical counterpart unless converted into fiat cash. It spans centralized commercial bank money, decentralized cryptocurrencies, and state-backed Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs).
importanceInUpsc: This topic is vital for UPSC CSE Prelims (monetary policy, RBI instruments, cryptocurrency regulations, and fintech indicators) and Mains GS Paper III (financial inclusion, mobilization of resources, digital economy, and macroeconomic stability).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Digital Money.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of money supply, fiat currency, and central banking.
